svg.title: How Catalyst explains a stock move
svg.desc: Market prices, peer moves, news and SEC filings go to an AI research desk: a news researcher names a reason and quotes the article, and a fact checker asks whether the article really explains the move. An editor with fixed rules publishes only if the quote is in the article, it came out before the move, it is about this company and the stock beat its peers. Example: Oracle rose 6.6% on December 19, 2025, Confirmed with a quote from coindesk.com while peers rose 0.6%. Otherwise the answer is Reported, With its group, No clear cause or Ordinary move.
